title: Roveia pinned client list (v2)
description: A dark, window-sized rounded panel that pins for four screens of scrolling: on the left a column of 70px client names slides up row by row, the current one bright and the others fading away (1, .5, .25, .1, .05); on the right a heading over the current client's wordmark, tags and paragraph, cross-fading with a full-panel background picture. On phones: a centred line over a two-column grid of wordmarks.
notes: desktop (≥1024px): sized by the window (calc(100svh − 2rem)) inside a 500svh wrapper; CSS scroll-driven, no JavaScript
the panel wraps itself in .dark; each brand's background slot takes a picture (object-fit: cover), empty it is a tinted placeholder
without scroll-driven animation support only the first brand's details show
name: roveia-v2-brands

props.name: heading
props.description: the line above the details (and above the grid on phones)
